card.name: The letter i inside bacter- and histor- words
card.fires_on: The single letter "i" when it follows "bacter" or "histor" and begins a longer word. Examples are bacteriostatic, bacteriologic, bacteriuria and historiography.

modes.label: bacteri- words
modes.description: The "i" after "bacter" in bacteriostatic, bacteriologic or bacteriuria, often in preservative statements.

modes.label: histori- words
modes.description: The "i" after "histor" in historiographer or historiography.
modes.example: German church histor<<i>>ography has generally abandoned the terms Anab

card.plain: It marks the spot in "bacteri-" and "histori-" words where the word is split and the letter i is the next piece.
